# kion_gcp_service_account (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion GcpServiceAccount by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_gcp_service_account" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the GcpServiceAccount to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `display_name` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `enable_federation_support` (Boolean)
- `gcp_project_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `oauth_client_id` (String)
- `oauth_client_secret` (String)
- `unique_id` (String)
